title: RegistryDumper
description: Dump formatted Tags, Recipes, and an Item list to help with compatibility development
body:
Adds commands to be able to export Tags, Recipes and Item lists after finding few to none tools to export in an easily readable and formatted way

Adds `/dumpitems` with a true flag to separate items into different namespace files

Adds `/dumptags` to create a folder in the resources/data format with all the tags, does not yet work for nested tags

Adds `/dumprecipes` to create a folder in the resources/data format with select recipe types

Vanilla Recipes include crafting, blasting, smelting, smoking, campfire_cooking, and stonecutting

Farmers Delight recipes, cooking and cutting

Brewin and Chewin recipes, fermenting and pouring
